heroSummary: AACPS begins the 2026–27 school year with a staggered opening. Students in grades 1–5, 6, and 9 attend on Monday, August 24, 2026. Schools are open for grades 1–12 beginning Tuesday, August 25. The scheduled last day for students is Friday, June 11, 2027.
calendarNotes: The 2026–27 AACPS calendar starts with a staggered opening week. August 24 is the first student opening day for grades 1–5 and grades 6 and 9 only, while schools are open for grades 1–12 beginning August 25. ECSE, pre-K, and kindergarten use conferences and staggered openings from August 24 through August 31. Project Unity days on October 13, December 8, February 9, and March 17 include two-hour early dismissal and no afternoon ECSE. Spring Break runs March 26–April 2, followed by an April 5 teacher workday before students return.

calendarFaqs.q: When does AACPS start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: AACPS begins the 2026–27 school year on Monday, August 24, 2026, for grades 1–5 and grades 6 and 9 only. Schools are open for grades 1–12 beginning Tuesday, August 25.

calendarFaqs.q: When is AACPS Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: AACPS Christmas/Winter Break runs from December 24, 2026, through January 1, 2027. Students return Monday, January 4, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is AACPS Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: AACPS Easter/Spring Break runs March 26 through April 2, 2027. April 5 is a teacher workday, so students return after the break on Tuesday, April 6.

calendarFaqs.q: When are AACPS Project Unity days in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: AACPS has four Project Unity days: October 13 and December 8, 2026, and February 9 and March 17, 2027. Schools dismiss two hours early on these dates, and afternoon ECSE is not held.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can families verify AACPS calendar updates?
calendarFaqs.a: Check AACPS’s official school calendar page and your school’s announcements for revisions, emergency closures, and school-specific schedules.

customSections.label: Weather Makeup and Virtual Learning
customSections.content: AACPS includes three makeup days at the end of the school year. If unused, makeup days may be deducted from the June closing date. If additional days are needed after the built-in makeup days, AACPS may add days to the June closing date or use virtual learning days when conditions permit.
